description: This file defines onboarding state management for an iOS application, including enumeration for connection modes and static methods for handling onboarding state persistence, such as whether onboarding has been completed, first run introduction visibility, and last connection mode information.

classes.name: OnboardingStateStore
classes.description: A struct-like container providing static methods and properties for managing onboarding state, including completion status, first run intro, last mode, and success time.

methods.name: shouldPresentOnLaunch
methods.description: Determines if onboarding should be presented when the app launches, based on completion status, last gateway connection, and app model.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed and optionally sets the last used connection mode and success timestamp.

methods.name: shouldPresentFirstRunIntro
methods.description: Checks if the first run introduction should be shown based on user defaults.

methods.name: markFirstRunIntroSeen
methods.description: Marks that the first run intro has been seen.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets onboarding state, marking it as incomplete and hiding the first run intro.

methods.name: lastMode
methods.description: Retrieves the last connection mode from user defaults, if set.
